title: The Quiet House
author: Cyrus Delacroix
blurb: Gideon Whitlock, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
